title: Write one yourself
hints: You need two steps: first x times x, then add 1.
Give the first step a name, like `%sq = mul %x %x`.

answer.code:
%x = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%sq  = mul %x %x
%out = add %sq 1
answer.explain: One line per step: `%sq = mul %x %x` makes x times x, and `%out = add %sq 1` adds one to it. Every bigger program in this course is built the same way, one small named step at a time.
